places: Timor Sea, Savu Sea, and Banda Sea

fields.climate: tropical; hot, humid; distinct rainy and dry seasons
fields.hazards: floods and landslides are common; earthquakes; tsunamis; tropical cyclones
fields.resources: gold, petroleum, natural gas, manganese, marble
fields.farm: maize, rice, coconuts, root vegetables, vegetables, cassava, other meats, pork, beans, coffee
fields.exports: crude petroleum, natural gas, coffee, scrap iron, telephones
fields.industries: printing, soap manufacturing, handicrafts, woven cloth
fields.languages: Tetun Prasa 30.6%, Mambai 16.6%, Makasai 10.5%, Tetun Terik 6.1%, Baikenu 5.9%, Kemak 5.8%, Bunak 5.5%, Tokodede 4%, Fataluku 3.5%, Waima'a 1.8%, Galoli 1.4%, Naueti 1.4%, Idate 1.2%, Midiki 1.2%…
fields.religions: Catholic 90.7%, other 7.1%, Protestant Evangelical 1.9%; less than 1%: Islam, Buddhist, Hindu
fields.legal: civil law system based on the Portuguese model
fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; according to Timorese law on military service, all citizens 18-30 must contribute to the defense of independence, sovereignty, and…
